description: Waze 5.24.5.0 (ARM64). Eight independent options: selectable map themes; selectable report icon packs; detailed report icons at normal sizes; local rank badge selector; unlock driver moods; Android Auto setup; adjustable Android Auto police alert distance; speed camera sound below the speed limit. Native icon-sizing profiles are now discovered and verified automatically during nightly builds. Includes Waze 5.24.0.2 and 5.24.5.0 compatibility, with all eight patches tested on both. Each profile checks the exact renderer and verifies the complete patched output. Future versions still require a successful nightly build and device testing.
